name: RTL-TCP
description: RTL-SDR TCP server for RTL-SDR dongles.

variables.name: Device Index
variables.description: RTL-SDR device index (0 for first device, 1 for second, etc.)

variables.name: Gain
variables.description: Gain setting for the RTL-SDR device. Use 0 for automatic gain.

variables.name: Buffers
variables.description: Number of buffers to use. Leave empty for default.

variables.name: List Buffers
variables.description: Max number of linked list buffers to keep

variables.name: PPM Error
variables.description: PPM error correction for the RTL-SDR device

variables.name: Sample Rate
variables.description: Sample rate in samples per second

variables.name: Enable bias-T on GPIO PIN 0
variables.description: Enable bias-T on GPIO PIN 0 (required for some devices)

variables.name: Internal Listening Port
variables.description: Internal port the interface listens on. Not recommended to change.

devices.name: RTL-SDR Devicr
devices.description: USB device to use for the RTL-SDR device
